# Robo Bionics

> > Award-winning bionic prosthetics and rehabilitation technology platform using mechanomyography (MMG) innovation to empower amputees with natural, functional limb solutions.

Robo Bionics is an India-based medical device company (Bionic Hope Private Limited) that develops EMG/MMG-based prosthetic hands and rehabilitation accessories. Featured on ZeeTV and Ideabaaz, the company combines 3D printing, ISO 13485:2016 certification, and clinical partnerships to deliver patient-centric bionic solutions aligned with UN ESG goals.

## Key Topics

- Mechanomyography (MMG)
- Prosthetic hands
- Grippy® prosthetics
- EMG technology
- BrawnBand
- WeightBand
- Bionic limbs
- Rehabilitation technology
- Amputee support
- Assistive technology
- 3D printing
- ISO 13485:2016
- Patient-centered care
- Clinical partnerships
- Social impact

## Core Products & Solutions

- [Patient – Robo Bionics](https://robobionics.in/patient): Patient-focused product page featuring 7-day independence program with Grippy and BrawnBand prosthetic solutions
- [Clinicians – Robo Bionics](https://robobionics.in/clinicians): Clinician partnership page offering EMG-based prosthetic solutions and rehabilitation technology for P&O clinics
- [What We Do – Robo Bionics](https://robobionics.in/what-we-do): Core technology page explaining award-winning mechanomyography (MMG) innovation for prosthetics and rehabilitation
- [Shop – Robo Bionics](https://robobionics.in/shop): E-commerce shop for prosthetic solutions, therapy accessories, and rehabilitation products including Grippy, BrawnBand, and WeightBand

## Company & Mission

- [Robo Bionics - Natural Prosthetics & Rehab Tech](https://robobionics.in): Homepage introducing Robo Bionics' bionic prosthetics and rehabilitation technology platform as seen on ZeeTV and Ideabaaz
- [Impact – Robo Bionics](https://robobionics.in/impact): CSR impact tracking platform demonstrating trackable social return on investment (S-ROI) and disability empowerment outcomes aligned with UN ESG goals
